text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright chose to grow at her own 
pace, but her progress left something to 
be desired.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Running alongside her classmate Seeking 
the Pearl ended in defeat. Days of steady, 
diligent training continue—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, a turning point arrived. Out of 
nowhere, Mejiro Bright displayed a 
performance so astounding, it was like 
looking at a completely different runner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She had been experiencing leg pain from 
her growth spurts. Deciding not to push 
herself until the pain subsided, she bided 
her time, waiting for the moment to take 
flight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Because she didn't push herself too hard, 
her leg was fully healed. It hit home that 
there was a reason for her taking things 
at her own pace—it was an absolute 
necessity.
